forum.title: LIS3MDL gyroscopic Behaviour
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @SaadRana17, to the community!

No, a MEMS magnetometer cannot act as a gyroscope.

The [LIS3MDL](https://www.st.com/en/mems-and-sensors/lis3mdl.html) has **already been discontinued** and is no longer available. It was a magnetometer that measures magnetic field, while a gyroscope measures angular rate. To approximate gyro-like behaviour, you would need a known magnetic reference field, careful calibration, and usually sensor fusion with other sensors such as an accelerometer.

Does it answer your question?

Regards

/Peter
